name: io.github.alikup-ai/otgate-opcua
title: otgate — OT policy gateway
description: Gates an LLM agent's writes to an OPC UA server on ranges, rate of change and live interlocks.

environmentVariables.name: OTGATE_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Backend to gate: 'fake' for the bundled in-memory reactor simulator, 'asyncua' for a real OPC UA server. Start with 'fake' — it needs no plant and no extra dependency.

environmentVariables.name: OTGATE_POLICY
environmentVariables.description: Path to the policy YAML. Any tag not listed in it is denied by default.

environmentVariables.name: OTGATE_AUDIT
environmentVariables.description: Path to the append-only JSONL audit log. Every call, allowed or not, produces exactly one line.

environmentVariables.name: OTGATE_SHADOW
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to run in shadow mode: allowed writes are recorded as 'WOULD execute' and never reach the backend. Use this to watch an agent for a while before letting it touch anything.

environmentVariables.name: OTGATE_RATE_HISTORY
environmentVariables.description: Path to a JSONL file that keeps the rate-of-change time base across restarts. Without it a restart loses the time base, and rate limits fall back to a one-interval allowance.

environmentVariables.name: OTGATE_OPCUA_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: OPC UA endpoint, e.g. opc.tcp://localhost:4840. Required when OTGATE_BACKEND=asyncua.
